Introduction:

Fulton Hogan Conduct significant roadworks in the busy cities across the country. It can be disruptive due to many occasions such as costs, management in traffic and dangers. As the Bad Ass Analytics Limited, he wants us to investigate if the school holidays would be a more appropriate time to plan out the roadworks in city areas. We are investigating largely in Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch in this investigation. Some key things we want to investigate are whether it’s best to plan roadworks for school holidays in CBD areas. Which days of the week are the best for roadworks if they need to complete it during the day. Lastly, are there any geographical differences between CBDs that we must be aware of.
